stories.title: Six-year-old Chinese girl ‘sets new women’s Rubik’s Cube world record’
stories.summary: Six-year-old Chinese speedcuber Lian Yunzhi has reportedly set a new women's 3x3 Rubik's Cube average world record. State media said she broke the record twice at World Cube Association-certified competitions in Wuhan and Guangzhou, averaging under 4.5 seconds.

stories.title: OpenAI’s George Osborne says datacentre nimbys holding back Britain
stories.summary: Former UK chancellor and OpenAI senior figure George Osborne says opposition to data centres is holding Britain back. He argues that the facilities are needed to maintain UK sovereignty over AI technology, while protests have focused on their heavy water and energy use.
